description: Canonical source and grid specification for the Night City map-aligned terrain model

source_dem.note: Large upstream source tile; not vendored in the repository. Use tools/build_night_city_heightfield.py with registration.json to regenerate the full aligned raster.

aligned_raster.integration_rule: Night City map point (x,y) samples aligned terrain raster pixel (x,y).

repository_terrain_representation.purpose: Compact project-wide terrain reference. Regenerate the full raster for quantitative work requiring per-pixel elevation.
